FN-U9NQ7GX-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 579
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Ginny Shaver
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 03/17/2026
House Bill 579 as introduced would decrease sales tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund,
county funds, and municipal funds by the estimated annual amounts listed below, beginning in
Fiscal Year 2027, based on information provided by the entity, by exempting Tigers for
Tomorrow, Inc., from paying state and local sales and use taxes:
Fund Tigers for Tomorrow
Education Trust Fund $10,110
County Funds $2,530
Municipal Funds $12,630
Total $25,270
Page 1

FN-U9NQ7GX-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 579
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Ginny Shaver
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 03/18/2026
House Bill 579 as reported by the Committee on Ways and Means Education would decrease
sales tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund by the estimated annual amount listed below,
beginning in Fiscal Year 2027, based on information provided by the entity, by exempting
Tigers for Tomorrow, Inc., from paying state sales and use taxes.
This bill could also decrease sales and use tax receipts to the following funds by the estimated
annual amounts shown, beginning in Fiscal Year 2027, based on information provided by the
entity, if the respective local governments adopt an exemption from local sales and use taxes,
pursuant to this bill:
Fund Tigers for Tomorrow
Education Trust Fund $10,110
County Funds $2,530
Municipal Funds $12,630
Total $25,270
Page 1
